scope: ARN and ATQ artifact only. Exact native full-card controls match the current public painter on all 59 frozen inputs. Shared source clipping intersects the aperture with measured colored-source bounds; art geometry is unchanged. HSV/gamma/WB uses independent calibration names and fixed poses. Actual full-card validation checks all printings, including regressions, and byte-identical illustration interiors. No production profile or Lab renderer is changed by this study.

method.scope: Real native full faces and fixed normalized scans. Existing words, typography, art rectangle and all nonartifact profile data are unchanged. Artifact illustration interiors must be byte-identical. Clip-only controls may change only stock-window boundary bands. Color fields use equal clamped filtering; paperClear uses an additional 11px closing to exclude lettering while the original 3px paper diagnostic is retained; every printing and outlier remains reported.

sourceFringe.scope: Opaque near-white pixels connected to the source perimeter; transparent art holes and enclosed light frame paper are excluded. Inverse source mapping and fractional aperture coverage estimate exposed source-stock area in canonical straight side strips. No scan pixels or per-card fit are used.

rejectedCandidate.reason: 3px ink suppression before pooled reference fitting did not improve full native paper fields; replaced with ink clearing per reference before pooling.
